TEXT (text_source=study_materials): two sections. p1 (section _1) carries its own complete question, so item_text = the P.1 question verbatim from cues3406.pdf ('En relación con ... poco o nada interesado/a.', line wraps joined, 'P.1 ' numbering stripped), section_prompt blank. p2_1..p2_7 (section _2) share the P.2 question, which is specific to them and so goes in section_prompt ('Concretamente, sobre los siguientes avances ... en cada uno de ellos?', verbatim), with item_text = the seven printed row labels (P2_5's line wrap 'Las energías no / contaminantes' joined). instructions blank: no text applies to both questions. Transcribed literally INCLUDING a source inconsistency: P.1's question text lists only 'muy interesado/a, bastante, poco o nada' (omitting 'algo'), while its printed response list and the value labels include 'Algo interesado/a' = 3 -- not corrected, disclosed here; P.2's text does list 'algo'. option_text = the five printed anchors = value labels 1-5. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3406 in Spanish only; the _translated columns were written by IRW (anchors 'Very interested','Quite interested','Somewhat interested','Not very interested','Not at all interested', matching the batch_371 spain_2023_science_activities rendering of the parallel 'interesante' scale; 'fecundación in vitro' -> 'In vitro fertilisation', 'energías no contaminantes' -> 'Non-polluting energies'). STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Interest in science and technology in general and in specific advances such as robotics, genetic engineering, space exploration, and nuclear energy' matches P.1 (general) + P.2 (seven advances); the .do comment names P1, P2_1 to P2_7 and live has exactly those eight codes. No instrument mismatch. SIBLINGS: spain_2023_science_science and spain_2023_science_situations were being extracted by other agents in parallel and were not touched; the benefits cache was read only. All scratch under .cache/spain_2023_science_interest/. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (line 117, verdict allow, every CIS survey year, irw#2381). public_note: The English in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered (CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only); resp 1 is 'very interested' and 5 'not at all interested', so higher values mean less interest; the general-interest question (p1) reads out only 'very, quite, not very or not at all' although its answer list also offers 'somewhat' (3), as printed by CIS; and the IRW processing script drops 'don't know'/'no answer' (305 responses in all) to missing.
